alignment_unsorted_exception.operation: throw Exception::IllegalArgument, 'Input to SpectrumAlignment is not sorted!'; the only precondition the source checks in this package

alignment_matrix_initialisation.operation: matrix[0][0] = 0 then matrix[i][0] = i * tolerance and matrix[0][j] = j * tolerance; gap cost is the tolerance, and cells the sparse map never stored fall back to (i - 1 + j - 1) * tolerance

alignment_band_tightening.operation: ++left_ptr when pos1 > pos2, diff > tolerance and j > left_ptr + 1; left_ptr is read once when the row's loop is initialised, so the increment takes effect on the next row

alignment_off_band_break.operation: off_band = true when the target peak has run past the reference peak and the next reference peak is still below it; the row ends there

alignment_tie_rules.operation: score_align <= score_up && score_align <= score_left && diff_align <= tolerance; the diagonal wins ties, and the tolerance boundary is inclusive

alignment_traceback_start.operation: Size i = last_i; the traceback starts at the last cell that chose the diagonal, not at the bottom-right corner, so trailing gaps are discarded

alignment_ppm_branch.operation: MatchedIterator<SpectrumType1, PpmTrait> it(s1, s2, tolerance); a float tolerance, a float window from ppmToMass, and a forward cursor that stops at the first equal adjacent distance

alignment_score_precondition.operation: OPENMS_PRECONDITION(!(use_linear_factor && use_gaussian_factor), ...); compiled out of a release build, after which the linear factor silently wins

alignment_score_ppm_window.operation: mz_tolerance = is_relative_tolerance ? tolerance * s1[ap.first].getMZ() * 1e-6 : tolerance; a double window with a different grouping from the float ppmToMass window that selected the pair, so a matched pair can fall outside it and give a negative linear factor

alignment_score_gaussian.operation: epsilon = mz_difference / (3.0 * mz_tolerance * sqrt(2)), then std::erfc(epsilon)

alignment_score_float_product.operation: sum += sqrt(s1[..].getIntensity() * s2[..].getIntensity() * factor); float * float is a single-precision multiply and only the result meets the double factor

alignment_score_denominator.operation: score = sum / (sqrt(sum1 * sum2)); one sqrt of a product, not the product of two sqrts, and unguarded against a zero denominator

zhang_not_implemented.operation: throw Exception::NotImplemented when is_relative_tolerance is set, next to a 'TODO remove parameter' comment; the parameter is still registered

zhang_pair_walk.operation: Size j_left(0) then for (Size j = j_left; ...); j_left is read at loop initialisation and written at line 169, so a write applies from the next reference peak, and a matched pair never advances it

zhang_strict_window.operation: if (fabs(pos1 - pos2) < tolerance); strict, unlike SteinScottImproveScore's inclusive <= 2 * epsilon

zhang_static_gaussian_denominator.operation: static const double denominator = mz_tolerance * 3.0 * sqrt(2.0); a function-local static, so the first call in a process fixes the Gaussian scale for every later call, instance and tolerance. Upstream defect; the port evaluates it per call

zhang_total_intensity_denominator.operation: score = sum / (sqrt(sum1 * sum2)) where sum1 and sum2 are total intensities, not squared ones; unguarded against zero

stein_scott_constant.operation: const double constant = epsilon / 10000, then z = constant * (sum3 * sum4) at line 88; the two totals are multiplied first

stein_scott_inclusive_window.operation: if (std::abs(pos1 - pos2) <= 2 * epsilon); twice the tolerance and inclusive

stein_scott_float_product.operation: sum += s1[i].getIntensity() * s2[j].getIntensity(); a float multiply widened on addition to the double accumulator

stein_scott_threshold_narrowing.operation: if (score < (float)param_.getValue("threshold")); the threshold narrows to float and is widened again for the comparison, so the default 0.2 compares as 0.20000000298023224

functor_naming.operation: setName(<derived>) after the base names the handler PeakSpectrumCompareFunctor, then defaults_.setValue(...) and defaultsToParam_(); identical at ZhangSimilarityScore.cpp:23 and SteinScottImproveScore.cpp:20. SpectrumAlignment.cpp:17 instead names its own handler directly

native_boundaries: A zero denominator yields a defined score of 0 in all three scorers, where the source divides by zero and returns NaN; this follows the convention the wave-A binned scorers already set in this module

Both weighting flags at once is Error::InvalidValue in SpectrumAlignmentScorer, whose upstream precondition is a release-build no-op, and in ZhangSimilarityScorer, which upstream silently prefers the Gaussian
ZhangSimilarityScorer's is_relative_tolerance is Error::Unsupported, the mapping of Exception::NotImplemented
A negative radicand under a weighting factor is a checked error instead of a NaN score; it is reachable through the disagreement between the alignment's float ppm window and the score's double one
Unsorted peaks are Error::UnsortedData everywhere, including in Zhang and Stein/Scott where the source does not check although its j_left cursor requires sorted input

Negative and non-finite intensities and non-finite coordinates, tolerances and thresholds are refused; for SteinScottImproveScorer the negative-intensity check is stricter than the formula needs and is a deliberate module-wide consistency choice
A negative tolerance is refused by the alignment, where the source silently produces an empty alignment

max_cells bounds the dynamic program and max_pairs the many-to-many walks. The alignment charges |s1| + |s2| + 1 before the matrix exists and each cell as it is filled; the walks allocate nothing at all, so a refusal leaves both inputs untouched. The source has no ceiling in either case
All intensity products are computed in f32 exactly as the source computes them, and every reduction is a sequential f64 accumulation in source order. No reduction is parallel or reassociated

The wave-A Copy structs SpectrumAlignment, SpectrumAlignmentScore, ZhangSimilarityScore and SteinScottImproveScore remain in the module. SpectrumAlignment is this package's alignment implementation, called by SpectrumAligner, so there is one alignment. The three scorers are not: they are parameter-free f64 conveniences with different traversals, groupings and degenerate-case policies. Collapsing each onto its faithful functor is the intended follow-up and was not done here because the merge changes values asserted in tests/comparison.rs, which this package is not permitted to edit
openmp: No #pragma omp in any of the four headers, their implementation files or MatchedIterator.h; no parallelism gap to record and the port is serial.
module_layout: All four ports live in src/comparison.rs rather than a src/comparison/ directory. tools/check_module_cycles.py derives its module set from the directories under src/, so creating src/comparison/ would make 'comparison' a tracked module and introduce seven edges that do not exist in docs/module-cycles.json (analysis, chemistry, format, identification, kernel and processing all name crate::comparison, and comparison names crate::param). The ratchet forbids widening, so the split is deferred rather than forced.
